text:
maria: quick Q — after merging the node-ts SDK PR that tightened package exports we started getting Vite builds failing for edge targets. repro: Next/Vite + edge adapter errors out during build with 'Cannot find module' even though CJS require works. also seeing streaming hang in edge functions when calling client.stream(...). anyone else run into both?

alex: yep saw the build error. it's the conditional exports + missing ESM entry for edge. Vite resolves the 'import' path and fails if it's not present. short fix is to add a small ESM bundle and exports map entry pointing to dist/edge/index.mjs. PR incoming (#345).

sam: streaming hang might be auth/runtime-env related. edge runtimes don't expose process.env, so if build-time inlining happened (`process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY`) the code ends up with an undefined runtime key and stream doesn't start. we added a runtime fallback to globalThis.__REDWOOD_KEY but need to ensure precedence: prefer runtime/globalThis over inlined values.

jules: confirmed on canary: repro across Next + Vite + Astro edge builds. temporary user workaround is to import the edge entry explicitly, eg `import client from '@redwood/inference/edge'` or construct with `apiKey: globalThis.__REDWOOD_KEY`. ugly tho.

maria: can we include a minimal snippet in the docs for recommended imports and vite config? something users can copy. also need a small migration note about env var precedence.

alex: yes — example I plan to add:```js
// recommended for edge runtimes
import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference/edge'
const c = createClient({ apiKey: globalThis.__REDWOOD_KEY })
```
and for bundles that inline envs: add this to vite.config.js:```js
export default {
  define: { 'process.env': {} },
  ssr: { noExternal: ['@redwood/inference'] }
}
```

sam: and for streaming on edge we had to stop using Node Readable streams. switch to async iterators or Web ReadableStream. example:```js
// edge-friendly streaming handler
for await (const chunk of client.stream(...)) {
  controller.enqueue(new TextEncoder().encode(chunk))
}
```

jules: CI results from canary: build ok for main packages, but streaming-edge tests failing (two tests) — looks like harness expects Node streams. I'll adapt tests to support ReadableStream in edge mode. ci-bot posted logs in #ci.

ci-bot: build succeeded for branch/canary (job 176): 102/104 tests passed. failing: streaming-edge.unit.js, streaming-edge.integration.js. artifacts: /artifacts/canary-176/logs.

alex: imma take review on #345 + the auth fallback PR. I'll add a unit for conditional exports resolution and a compact integration test using Vite's build API against our edge export. will also add changelog entry about "explicit edge entrypoint" and env precedence.

sam: streaming hang root cause summary — Node stream polyfills caused backpressure mismatch in edge adapters. fix: expose streaming as async iterator from SDK and provide a helper that turns it into a ReadableStream when running in the browser/edge. pushed branch "streaming/edge-iter".

jules: small doc note: call out that process.env inlined values will mask runtime-provided keys in some bundlers, so recommend using globalThis or an adaptor in serverless. i'll draft the paragraph.

maria: thanks all. can someone ping me when #345 and the streaming branch are merged? we should cut a patch release once CI green and tests adjusted. would prefer to ship today to reduce support backlog. :pray:
